items.title: Sara: Marcos sees me as threat since 2023
items.description: Instead of explaining her alleged ties to Chinese money, Vice President Sara Duterte claimed she was being targeted by the administration, and has been considered a “threat” by President Marcos since 2023.

items.title: Philippines eyes ‘green revolution’
items.description: The Marcos administration will embark on a campaign to encourage the public to reuse water and revive a “green revolution” to ease the impact of a “super El Niño.”

items.title: Sara, Bong Go top choices for president, VP – Pulse
items.description: Vice President Sara Duterte and Sen. Bong Go remained the most preferred candidates for president and vice president, respectively, according to a recent survey conducted by Pulse Asia.

items.title: Prosecutors forgo plan to call Sara as witness
items.description: The prosecution team of the House of Representatives has decided to forego its plan to call Vice President Sara Duterte as a hostile witness at her impeachment trial, saying pressing her into taking the witness stand would only be an exercise in futility.

items.title: ERC orders Meralco to refund P2.64 billion to customers
items.description: Regulators have ordered Manila Electric Co. to return an additional P2.64 billion to its customers over six months, offering temporary relief as higher distribution charges kick in.

items.title: House votes 281-13 to pass 2027 budget
items.description: Voting 281-13 with one abstention, the House of Representatives approved on third and final reading last night the Marcos administration’s proposed P7.2-trillion national budget for 2027.

items.title: DOE chief also on way out?
items.description: Energy Secretary Sharon Garin leaves her fate to President Marcos amid calls for her resignation, this time over the power crisis besetting the Visayas.

items.title: DMW: No deployment ban for Saudi-bound OFWs
items.description: Despite the recent attack on Saudi Arabia’s King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, which resulted in 12 deaths and over 300 hurt, the Department of Migrant Workers said there will be no deployment ban in Saudi Arabia.

items.title: NBI probing properties linked to Duterte family
items.description: The National Bureau of Investigation is zeroing in on several properties linked to Vice President Sara Duterte and other family members after finding major discrepancies in declared values in her statement of assets, liabilities and net worth and the agency’s initial estimates.
